I am old now, 51 years, and I have never gone to school, but I know my maize plot well. This land is small, less than half a hectare, but it is the food for my household so I must give it what I can. If I get the FISP coupon this year I will put fertilizer — one bag of NPK at planting and one of urea when the maize is knee-high — but I must spread it carefully because the plot is intercropped with beans and pigeon pea. I cannot afford to hire much labor or buy pesticide, so I will work with my own hands and use the manure from around the house.
